# IMDb

> > IMDb (Internet Movie Database) is the world's most comprehensive database of movies, TV shows, and entertainment content with user-curated lists and recommendations.

IMDb provides extensive information on films, television series, actors, directors, and crew members. The platform features user-generated lists covering genres from horror to period dramas, along with ratings, reviews, and detailed filmographies.

## Key Topics

- Movie and TV databases
- User-curated lists
- Horror films
- Period dramas
- True crime documentaries
- Underrated and overlooked films
- Film recommendations
- Victorian era entertainment
- Killer animal movies
- Russian and Soviet cinema
- TV series rankings
- Genre-specific curation
- Film directors and actors
- Historical costume dramas

## Horror Film Collections

- [Overlooked/Underrated Horror Films](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls032853033/): User-curated list of underrated horror films like Wrong Turn
- [Killer Animal/Insects and Giants Monsters (Horror) Movies](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls050510252/): User list of creature features and killer animal horror movies

## Television Series Lists

- [Best 100 TV Series](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls052258183/): Personal top 100 TV series list including Twin Peaks and classics
- [True Crime TV Series, Docuseries & Documentaries](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls028157820/): Curated collection of true crime shows featuring O.J. Simpson & more

## Period and Historical Cinema

- [Period Dramas-The Victorian Era 1837-1901](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls000066901/): Victorian era period dramas featuring Queen Victoria's reign films

## International Cinema

- [The 55 Best Russian and Soviet Films](https://m.imdb.com/list/ls026478888/): Curated collection of 55 best Russian and Soviet cinema classics
